purpose: Cover every acceptance criterion of US-208 with one node:test case each in test/view/query-routes.test.js; DEFINE lands the named declarations flagged not yet built so the strict coverage audit binds each criterion, and BUILD (FBS-207) removes the flags as it makes them pass.

testCases.description: [happy] Given a running viewer and a known id, when GET "./trace.json?id=<id>&direction=forward" is requested, then the response is application/json carrying the computeTrace result for that pivot (pivot, direction, found, nodes, edges), computed from the current state and served with "cache-control: no-store" relative to the viewer mount.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/query-routes.test.js::AC-208-1 happy: a running viewer and a known id

testCases.description: [happy] Given a running viewer and a known id, when GET "./impact.json?id=<id>" is requested, then the response is application/json carrying the computeImpact result (pivot, found, nodes with actionNeeded per node, edges) with "cache-control: no-store".
testCases.testPointer: test/view/query-routes.test.js::AC-208-2 happy: a running viewer and a known id

testCases.description: [happy] Given a running viewer, when GET "./coverage.json" is requested with no scope, then the response is application/json carrying the strict computeCoverage result for the whole tree (totals, requirements, unresolvedTestPointers); given "?scope=<id>" naming a PRD, REQ or US, the result is narrowed to that subtree as the CLI positional narrows it.

[failure] Given an unknown id, when trace or impact is requested, then the response is 404 application/json with QueryRouteError.error "unknown-id" and QueryRouteError.id echoing the request; given a direction outside forward, back and both, the response is 400 with QueryRouteError.error "bad-direction"; given a below-AC or unknown scope on coverage, the response is 400 with QueryRouteError.error "bad-scope".

[must-not] Given any request to the three routes, when the server handles it, then runWithAdmissibilityGate is not called (the routes bypass the gate the way src/cli/coverage.js and src/cli/impact.js do) and nothing under rcf/ is written.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/query-routes.test.js::AC-208-5 must-not: any request to the three routes

testCases.description: [edge] Given a rewalk that publishes a new state.version, when a route is requested, then the served result reflects the new tree and the memo entries of the previous version are discarded; within one version a repeated request for the same pivot and direction is served from the memo without recomputing.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/query-routes.test.js::AC-208-6 edge: a rewalk that publishes a new stateversion

testCases.description: [failure] Given the server before the first walk completes, when a trace, impact or coverage request arrives, then the response is 503 text "view server initialising", as ./index.json answers today.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/query-routes.test.js::AC-208-7 failure: the server before the first walk completes
